project.title: Microalgae-bacteria consortia
project.description: Microalgae-bacteria consortia enriched from waste activated sludge in waste water treatment plant in Ulsan, South Korea.Cultivated under diluted anaerobic digestion effluent and biogas supply.5,000 lx LED, 16h light/8 h dark cycle, 3.5L photobioreactor
project.center_name: Ulsan National Institute of Science and Technology
